description: This Java class 'TaxUtils' provides utility methods for calculating and splitting tax amounts, including total tax, income amount after tax, and adding tax to amounts, based on tax components and group mappings within the Fineract project.

classes.name: TaxUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for tax calculations such as splitting tax, calculating income after tax, total tax, and adding tax to amounts.

methods.name: splitTax
methods.description: Splits a given amount into tax components based on group mappings and applicable percentages for a specific date.

methods.name: splitTaxData
methods.description: Splits a given amount into tax components based on data transfer objects and applicable percentages for a specific date.

methods.name: incomeAmount
methods.description: Calculates the income amount after deducting total tax from the original amount, based on tax group mappings.

methods.name: incomeAmount
methods.description: Calculates the income amount after deducting total tax, given a map of tax components and their amounts.

methods.name: totalTaxAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total tax amount from a map of tax components and their respective tax values.

methods.name: totalTaxDataAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total tax amount from a map of tax component data objects and their respective tax values.

methods.name: addTax
methods.description: Calculates the total amount including tax, based on a base amount, date, tax group mappings, and scale.
